description:
We are a team of young innovators passionate about technology, science, and problem-solving. Our interests include software development, artificial intelligence, data science, and scientific innovation.

For the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, we aim to transform creative ideas into practical solutions using technology and NASA's open data.

We are looking for: Developers, AI/ML enthusiasts, data analysts, UI/UX designers, GIS specialists, science enthusiasts, and creative thinkers.
